title: Flame Eveque - Location, Weakness & Triple Fight Guide
description: Flame Eveque in Expedition 33's Flying Manor is part of a triple boss fight with a randomised invulnerability mechanic. Weakness, location and rewards.

facts.label: Key Drops
facts.value: Kralim · Grandiose Chroma Catalyst x6 · Colour of Lumina x5

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Flame Eveque is one of three elemental Eveque variants, alongside the Frost Eveque and Thunder Eveque. In the Flying Manor it appears as part of a triple boss fight - you face all three at once.

sections.title: Where to Find the Flame Eveque
sections.content:
Location: Flying Manor (plus the Endless Tower).

The Flying Manor is a post-game area reached with Esquie's flight ability, unlocked after finishing The Monolith. It is a floating island southwest of Monoco's Station - from The Continent map, track the Forgotten Battlefield exit and fly northwest of the mountains until you find floating land with roof rubble.

Inside: from the Plaza Rest Point, head toward the display cases containing an Eveque and go past them. Jump through the floating picture frames and the boss waits in a dim room.

Endless Tower

The Flame Eveque also appears in the Endless Tower as the notable enemy of Stage 7 Trial 1 and Stage 9 Trial 3.

sections.title: How to Beat the Triple Eveque Fight
sections.content:
The invulnerability mechanic

This is the part that catches people out. In the Flying Manor encounter, one of the three Eveques is invulnerable at any given time, indicated by a golden shield beside its name under the health bar.

  • The invulnerable one is randomised per attempt - it is not always the same Eveque
  • Use free aim to check which one is currently protected before committing skills
  • You must neutralise the vulnerable Eveque first, then move to the next

Elemental discipline

Each of the three absorbs its own element and resists nearly everything else. Because you are fighting all three at once, a single weapon element will be absorbed by one of them - so avoid AoE elemental skills entirely and use focused single-target attacks.

Recommended damage

Lune for Ice, and Maelle's Void skills. Fextralife specifically recommends leaning on parrying because of how high the trio's resistances are - counterattacks bypass the elemental problem.
